name: Alabama

agency.name: State Oil and Gas Board of Alabama

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill, Deepen, Convert or Amend
form.notes: The blank OGB-1 PDF could not be found, so it was not read; form cells come from Rule 400-1-2-.01 (read in full, revised 8/12/24) and the GIS layer schema. Filed with: $300 fee (none to convert or deepen), surveyor plat in triplicate (surface and bottom-hole locations, lat/long, state plane, unit boundaries), Affidavit of Ownership or Control (OGB-2, 2C, 2D), bond (OGB-3 single or OGB-4 blanket), Organization Report (OGB-5). Permit expires 6 months after issue if not spudded. The URL is the rule chapter, not the form.

operator_id.n: Layer has an internal EntityKey only; Organization Report OGB-5 not read

bond.n: Bond on Form OGB-3 (single well) or OGB-4 (blanket) with the application unless on file

surface_plss.n: SecNum, Township, Range and PLSS text

bottom_hole_loc.n: HasBHL flag; separate Bottomhole Locations and Lines layers in the service (names only, not queried)

lateral_path.n: A Bottomhole Lines layer exists; not queried, so path vs straight line unknown

surface_owner.n: Not in the rule; OGB-1 and plat contents beyond the rule not read

well_type.n: WellType and TypeDesc (CM, GAS, OIL, SWD, WI, WS, UN)

work_type.n: Forms OGB-1 (drill, deepen, convert, amend), 1A (re-entry), 1B (directional); not a layer field

well_direction.n: Directional wells use Form OGB-1B; the layer only has a HasBHL flag

proposed_depth_md.n: OGB-1 not read; layer MD, TVD, DTD, LTD may be drilled depths, not proposed

proposed_depth_tvd.n: OGB-1 not read; layer TVD is not labeled proposed or as drilled

target_formation.n: PoolName is the pool, not necessarily the target on the permit

frac_dates.n: Treatment report (Form OGB-6) is due 30 days after fracturing; the form was not found, so its fields are unverified

frac_chemicals.n: Rules ask only for 'the method used in treating the well'; no chemical or FracFocus rule found; form not read

frac_additives.n: No rule found naming trade names, suppliers or purposes; Form OGB-6, which could ask for them, was not found

frac_amounts.n: No rule found asking for ingredient amounts; Form OGB-6 was not found and the well layer has no such field

spacing_unit.n: DrillingUnitAcres, DrillingUnitDescription, UnitName; plat must show the spacing unit

spacing_exception.n: Non-compliant applications go to Board hearing (rule 400-1-2-.01(5)); no exception field seen

mineral_owner.n: Affidavit of Ownership or Control (Form OGB-2): 100% of drilling rights in the unit

fee.n: $300 payable to State Treasurer; none for convert or deepen

notice_hearing.n: Board approves non-compliant applications after due notice and hearing

date_expires.n: Rule: expires 6 months after issuance if not spudded; no field seen

spud_date.n: SpudDate; 14,906 of 16,236 rows filled (a future value 2047 is in the data)

completion_date.n: Layer has FirstProductionDate and StatusDate but no completion date

status.n: WellStatus, StatusDesc, StatusDate (Permitted Well, Producing, Active...)

production_link.n: Layer has FirstProductionDate; production reports not checked

sources.name: OGB Online Map: Wells (MapServer layer 0)
sources.license: none stated; service metadata asks for a written data request for formal use
activity_types: permit by well type: coal bed methane, gas, oil, water disposal, water injection, water source, undesignated
sources.tested: Four small requests: service?f=json (200, 6 KB, 16 layers incl. Wells, Well Units, Bottomhole, Fields, CBM, Offshore), layer 0?f=json (200, 151 KB, 49 fields), one statistics query (16,236 wells; 16,011 with PermitDate from 1940-08-13 to 2026-10-28; 14,906 with SpudDate) and one query of 116 permits since 2023-01-01 with no geometry or names. maxRecordCount 2000, formats JSON/geoJSON/PBF. Permits per month since 2023: 1 to 12 (about 30 a year; 86 of the 116 are coal bed methane, 20 still "Permitted Well").

sources.name: OGB web application (well search and details, GSA/OGB)
sources.tested: Home page GET: 200, 8.7 KB, an AngularJS shell (well search, details, ng-csv, pdf.js scripts). Behind it are API calls that were not inspected; no forms page or form PDF found.

grade_reason: A free, reachable ArcGIS layer with one row per well, a PermitDate (filled for 99%, newest 2026-10-28), SpudDate, well type, county, region and coordinates; monthly permit counts can be queried directly. Weak points: no work-type field (deepen, convert, re-entry are not separated), and volume is small (about 30 permits a year, most coal bed methane).
producer_plan: Query MapServer/0/query with where=PermitDate >= DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD', returnGeometry=false and outFields Permit, API, PermitDate, SpudDate, WellType, TypeDesc, WellStatus, CountyName, Region; page with resultOffset (2000 per page). Convert the epoch-millisecond PermitDate to a date (check the time zone against a few known permits) and count by month; split by WellType (OIL and GAS as new drill, SWD and WI as injection, CM coal bed methane and WS water source as other). Spud counts come from SpudDate. Watch: the layer is one row per well, so a later deepen or convert permit may not add a row; a future SpudDate (2047) exists, so cap dates; rows with status "Permitted Well" are permits not yet drilled. The refresh cadence is unknown: compare the monthly count of a past month on two dates.
privacy_notes: The layer holds operator names and a free-text Comment field (91 of 116 recent rows have one; not read). Check Comment and operator names against the tracker rule before publishing. No contact details in the schema.
